increment: restored source lighting, native CSM shadows, restored facility/airlock/ceiling systems (final revision: R01/R02 source-disabled equivalences fixed)

fixes: R01 FIXED: static-structure.ts parents every frozen batch whose first entity name starts with 'airshower-' to a hidden 'static-source-disabled' root; source legacy-site.ts:406-407 disables those early procedural air showers once original airlocks exist and they can no longer be re-shown by setVisible/setLevel cascades.

R02 FIXED: the frozen procedural ceiling layer ('ffu' = ceiling-frame/panel/fan/hub from buildProceduralFab) stays source-disabled (legacy-site.ts:412); the preview FFU view maps to the restored original facility ceiling only (facility.setCeilingVisible(view==='ffu')).
revision.sourceChangesNote: In addition to the R01/R02 fixes, the final lighting.ts revision packs the source local-light UBO once per frame with an allocation-free change hash (public API only; pixel-neutral by intent); the final .local/lite-acceptance-final/ captures were generated after this change.

method.resize: only the old product reference is resized, 3072x1470 -> 1536x735 LANCZOS; canonical layout captures are measured at native 1536x735
method.luminance: Rec.709 Y = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B on raw sRGB byte values (not linearized)

metrics.signed_mean_luminance_delta: mean (luminance(B) - luminance(A)); negative means B darker
metrics.changed_fraction_gt8: fraction of ROI pixels whose max channel |delta| > 8
